title: Buna
logline: Three cups of coffee turn a quiet morning into a blessing shared.
audience: Ethiopians and the Habesha diaspora, roughly 18 to 35, watching short vertical video on their phones, plus curious viewers who have never sat through a coffee ceremony.
intent: Viewers should feel the unhurried warmth of a home where coffee is made for others, and think either 'I miss this' or 'I want to sit at that table'.
style_block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft film grain, visible brush texture, glowing charcoal-orange against earthy browns and soft morning light, gentle and slightly nostalgic mood, no text, no logos, no photorealistic faces.
negative_style: photorealistic faces, text, letters, watermark, logo, modern appliances, plastic objects

characters.host: an illustrated Ethiopian woman in a white cotton dress with a woven coloured border and a shawl, hair wrapped, seen mostly from behind, in profile, or as hands only; an invented character, not a portrait of any real person
characters.guests: illustrated neighbours and family seated on low wooden stools in a half circle, shown as warm silhouettes and soft shapes, faces softly stylised and never realistic

narrator.style: Say warmly, slowly and unhurried, like an adult remembering a morning from childhood

neighbor.style: Say with a warm, friendly invitation

elders.style: Say as an older person giving a gentle blessing

shots.reason: Establishes where and when: a home courtyard at dawn, ready for the ceremony.
shots.image_prompt: Wide view of a traditional Ethiopian home interior doorway at dawn, fresh green grass strewn on the floor, a low wooden stool and a small charcoal brazier, thin smoke rising, soft morning light.
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in toward the brazier; the smoke drifts upward.

shots.reason: The ceremony begins with fire: the smell of roasting coffee is the signature of the ritual.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of green coffee beans being shaken in a flat iron pan over glowing charcoal, a woman's hands holding the long handle, white cotton sleeve with a woven border, no face visible, smoke curling up.
shots.motion_prompt: The hands shake the pan gently; smoke curls; the camera stays locked off.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_en: When the coffee roasts, its smell fills the house.

shots.reason: Sharing the aroma: the host offers the smoke to her guests before anything is poured.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of a woman's hands carrying the roasting pan toward seated guests, smoke trailing toward soft silhouettes of neighbours on low stools, warm light.
shots.motion_prompt: The pan moves slowly across the frame; the camera pans gently with it.

shots.reason: The labour of the ritual: coffee is pounded by hand, nothing is rushed.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of roasted dark coffee beans in a wooden mortar and a woman's hands pounding with a long pestle, white cotton sleeve with a woven border, no face visible.
shots.motion_prompt: The pestle rises and falls slowly; the camera stays locked off.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_en: She pounds the coffee by hand.

shots.reason: The clay pot is the heart of the ceremony: the film shows its shape and its steam.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a black clay coffee pot with a long neck sitting on a small ring of glowing charcoal, steam rising from its spout, fresh grass around it.
shots.motion_prompt: Steam drifts upward; the camera tilts up slowly along the pot.

shots.reason: The human moment: guests arrive and are invited to sit and drink.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of an illustrated woman seated beside the clay pot gesturing a warm welcome toward guests on low stools, faces softly stylised and turned slightly away, glowing charcoal between them.
shots.motion_prompt: She gestures an invitation; the camera stays still.

shots.reason: The first round, named for its place in the ritual, is poured high in one stream.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of coffee being poured from the long spout of a clay pot in one high arc into a line of small handleless cups on a tray, steam rising.
shots.motion_prompt: The stream pours steadily; the camera pushes in gently.

shots.reason: The second round shows the ritual's rhythm: the same pot, filled again.
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of the clay pot being refilled with water over the charcoal while guests hold small cups in soft focus behind it.
shots.motion_prompt: The camera pulls out slowly to include more guests.

shots.reason: The third round, the blessing, is the emotional turn: the cup is passed with a wish.
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of two hands passing a small cup of coffee to an older seated guest, warm glowing charcoal between them, grass on the floor, faces softly stylised and turned away.
shots.motion_prompt: The cup passes from hand to hand; the camera stays locked off.

narration.speaker: narrator
narration.text_en: Baraka, the third round, when the blessing comes.

shots.reason: The closing image the author asked for: the whole circle seen together, smoke rising.
shots.image_prompt: Extreme wide shot of a home interior with the host, guests in a half circle on low stools, the clay pot and thin smoke rising, warm light, all as small illustrated silhouettes.
shots.motion_prompt: The camera pulls out slowly; the smoke rises.

narration.speaker: elders
narration.text_am: አንድ ቡና፣ ብዙ ሰው፣ አንድ ልብ።
narration.text_en: One coffee, many people, one heart.

cues.caption: Gentle warm acoustic texture, soft plucked strings and a light hand drum, slow and unhurried, no strong lead melody, leaves room for a spoken voice, instrumental.

song_experiment.plan: Dropped for the coffee film; see DESIGN.md.
